headline: Everything you own in one number
lead: Accounts, deposits, bonds, ETFs, crypto, property and loans. Neto values them daily and shows how your net worth changes.
metaTitle: Neto: everything you own in one number
metaDescription: Track your net worth: accounts, deposits, Polish treasury bonds, stocks, ETFs, crypto, property and loans in one place, valued daily in PLN. An information tool with no investment advice.
heroNote: You enter the data yourself or import it from CSV. Neto does not connect to your bank.
illustrationLabel: Illustrative example: assets above the zero line, liabilities below it, and the net worth line between them.
feature1Body: Bank accounts, deposits, treasury bonds, stocks and ETFs, funds, crypto, property and loans. Assets and liabilities in any currency.
feature2Body: Exchange rates from the National Bank of Poland. Every value shows the date of its price, and stale valuations are clearly marked.
feature3Body: Retail treasury bonds valued by formula, deposits with compounding, IKE, IKZE and PPK accounts.
feature4Body: Set a goal and check your pace. The calculator shows three scenarios based on assumptions you change yourself. It is a simulation, not a forecast.
feature5Body: One account in the browser on every device. You can add Neto to your phone's home screen like an app.
feature6Body: Two-step sign-in, encryption of sensitive fields, a list of sessions. Export your data and delete your account at any time.
not1: It does not advise what to invest in or recommend instruments.
not2: It does not hold money or place orders.
not3: It does not connect to your bank or broker.
not4: It shows no ads and does not track you across websites.
faq1Q: Does Neto tell me what to invest in?
faq1A: No. Neto shows the data you enter and calculations based on it. It does not recommend instruments or judge your decisions. If you need advice, talk to a licensed adviser.
faq2Q: Do I have to connect my bank account?
faq2A: No. You enter transactions and balances by hand or import a CSV file from your bank or broker.
faq3Q: Where do prices and exchange rates come from?
faq3A: Exchange rates come from National Bank of Poland tables. Instrument prices come from an external data provider or you enter them yourself. Valuation runs once a day, so prices may be delayed.
faq4A: On our server, so it is the same in the browser on every device. We encrypt sensitive fields and never write amounts to logs. The details are in the privacy policy.
faq5A: Without a connection you will only see a notice that you are offline. We deliberately do not store your financial data on the device.
faq6Q: How do I delete my account?
faq6A: In settings, under Data. Step-by-step instructions are on the {link} page.
ctaTitle: See everything you own in one place
ctaBody: All you need is an e-mail address and a password.
disclaimer: Neto is an information tool. Its data and calculations are not investment advice or a recommendation. The value of investments can go down as well as up, and valuations may be delayed. More: {link}.
offlineBody: Neto needs an internet connection to show your data. We do not keep it on your device, so there is nothing to display while you are offline.
